bar under an AI message – copy turns into a check, regenerate spins and unfolds a version switcher, thumbs pop and ask why, read aloud becomes a tiny equalizer. $ pnpm dlx shadcn@latest add https://www.affectui.com/r/message-actions-clean.json Preview Code Copy prompt MCP Copy Summarize the 2.4 release notes in one sentence. Sonnet 5.5 Version 2.4 adds shared workspaces, cuts sync time in half and fixes the export bug on Windows. Copy Regenerate 1 / 1 Good response Bad response Read aloud What went wrong? Not accurate Too long Didn't follow instructions Other Send When to use Under every assistant message in a chat – copy, try again, rate and listen without leaving the conversation Wherever a model can answer more than once and people should be able to flip between the answers When you collect feedback on answers and want a reason, not just a thumb When not to use Under the user's own messages – edit and delete fit there better than regenerate and rating For a long list of actions – keep it to the four; put the rest in a menu When the answer is still streaming – show a stop button instead and bring the bar in once it is done Installation Add Message Actions with the shadcn CLI – your project needs a components.json, see Installation in the docs – or copy the file by hand. Requires React 19. CLI Manual pnpm npm yarn bun Copy pnpm dlx shadcn@latest add https://www.affectui.com/r/message-actions-clean.json Usage example.tsx Copy import { MessageActions, MessageText } from "@/components/ui/message-actions-clean"; export function AssistantMessage({ message }) { const [version, setVersion] = useState(message.versions.length - 1); const text = message.versions[version]; return ( // data-ui-message lets the bar light up while the whole message is hovered
{text} regenerate(message.id)} onFeedback={(kind, reason) => saveFeedback(message.id, version, kind, reason)} />
); } Examples Spinning while a new version is written example.tsx Copy const [writing, setWriting] = useState(false); { setWriting(true); const next = await regenerate(message.id); setVersions((v) => [...v, next]); setVersion(versions.length); // jump to the new one setWriting(false); }} /> Real read aloud with the Web Speech API example.tsx Copy const [speaking, setSpeaking] = useState(false); { speechSynthesis.cancel(); if (play) { const u = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(text); u.onend = () => setSpeaking(false); speechSynthesis.speak(u); } setSpeaking(play); }} /> API reference MessageActions Prop Type Default Description text string – The message text – Copy writes it to the clipboard, and an uncontrolled read aloud is timed by its length actions MessageActionKey[] ["copy", "regenerate", "feedback", "speak"] Which actions to show and in what order. feedback is the thumbs up and down versions number | string[] 1 All versions of the message, or just how many there are. From two on the "‹ 2 / 3 ›" switcher unfolds next to Regenerate version number – Controlled version, 0-based defaultVersion number newest Starting version when uncontrolled. Uncontrolled, the switcher jumps to a version as soon as it is added onVersionChange (index: number) => void – Called with the version picked in the switcher onCopy (text?: string) => void – Called after Copy, with text onRegenerate () => void – Called when Regenerate is pressed – add a version to versions and it shows up in the switcher regenerating boolean false Keeps the arrow spinning and the bar lit while a new version is written onFeedback (kind: "up" | "down" | null, reason?: string) => void – Called with the vote right away, with null when it is taken back, and once more with "down" and a reason when the feedback row is sent. A new version starts without a vote reasons string[] Not accurate, Too long, Didn't follow instructions, Other Quick reasons in the feedback row. "Other" unfolds a small text field whose words are sent as the reason onSpeak (playing: boolean) => void – Called with true when Read aloud starts and false when it stops speaking boolean – Controlled playing state – tie it to your speech player. Without it the bar plays for speakDuration and stops on its own speakDuration number from text, at least 2600 How long an uncontrolled read aloud plays, in ms quiet boolean true Faded until the message (an ancestor with data-ui-message) or the bar is hovered or focused. Touch screens always show it fully label string "Message actions" Accessible name of the bar className string – Extra class on the root Keyboard interactions Tab Through the actions, the version arrows and – when it is open – the reasons and Send Enter or Space Presses an action, picks or drops a reason, sends Enter In the "Other" text field: sends Esc Closes the feedback row and puts focus back on thumbs down Accessibility Each action is a button with its own name; the thumbs and Read aloud are toggle buttons with aria-pressed, thumbs down has aria-expanded for the feedback row Tooltips repeat the button names, so they are hidden from screen readers; they also show on keyboard focus Copied, the version you switched to, Reading aloud and Thanks are announced through a polite live region The version arrows are disabled at either end, and the count is read as "Version 2 of 3" While closed, the feedback row is inert – nothing hidden can be focused Motion Copy blurs into a green check; it turns back after a moment Regenerate spins once per press, and keeps spinning while regenerating is true A vote gives the thumb a small pop and the selected-tab look; the feedback row unfolds below the bar and folds away after Thanks The version switcher unfolds sideways from Regenerate; its number crossfades, and MessageText crossfades the message while its height eases Read aloud swaps the speaker for four bouncing blue bars With prefers-reduced-motion everything switches without movement and the bars stand still Responsive behavior The bar is about 220px wide with the switcher; the feedback row has no card of its own – it fills its container (ideally the last row of your message card) and its reasons wrap Below 320px the Send button takes its own line under the reasons Touch screens: 36px buttons, taller reasons, no hover tooltips (only "Copied"), and the bar is never faded Dark mode built in: switches when an ancestor (usually ) has the class dark or data-theme="dark" Notes for AI Give your coding assistant this summary instead of screenshots. Put data-ui-message on the element that wraps the message and the bar – that is what lights the quiet bar up on hover Keep versions per message in your state and pass version + onVersionChange; after a regenerate, set version to the new last index onFeedback fires twice for a thumbs down with a reason – once with only the vote, once with the reason. Upsert by message and version instead of inserting rows The bar does not speak by itself – pass speaking and onSpeak and drive speechSynthesis or your TTS from there Related AI Answer Chat Streamed answer with source cards, citation chips that preview their source, copy, regenerate, feedback and follow-ups Reaction Bar Buttons Like, comment, repost and share in one pill – icons pop and fill, counts roll in digit by digit Chat Composer Chat Prompt composer with model picker, voice input, app connections and approval request Thinking State Chat AI working panel with a live timer, searched sources and thinking steps that appear one by one affectUI · 54 components · 12 screens · 11 blocks · 24 illustrations · 8 motion effects affectUI Agent-ready React UI for AI products – one file each, no dependencies.
